name: Chemcon Speciality Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Chemcon Speciality Chemicals Ltd manufactures Pharmaceutical intermediates and Oilfield Chemicals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CSCL is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified manufacturer of silanes, pharma intermediates, agro intermediates, and oil field chemicals. It is the largest manufacturer of specialised chemicals like HMDS and CMIC, predominantly used in the pharmaceutical industry.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -4.57% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.05% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.14.9 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 8.86% of profits over last 3 years
